question:
Among the posts with a score of over 5, what is the percentage of them being owned by an elder user?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: score of over 5 refers to Score > 5; elder user refers to Age > 65; percentage = Divide (Count(Id where Age>65), Count(Id)) * 100

prediction.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.XCL_064 > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM posts AS "p" JOIN users AS "u" ON "p".XCL_033 = "u".XCL_052 WHERE p.XCL_030 > 5

WHERE p.XCL_030 > 5
